ex.title: How to play
ex.soundBlocked: Sound is off — click to turn it on
ex.s1: The Mystery Stock Market. Seven companies. The rules… unknown.
ex.s2: Every stock opens at ten thousand marks. You start rich: one hundred thousand in cash, and three pieces.
ex.s3: Each round, buy and sell whole shares. Prices stay frozen until the round ends.
ex.s4: Then every stock jumps to its new price, all at once.
ex.s5: Each stock follows its own hidden rule. At first you see only a few words. More are revealed in rounds five, ten, fifteen and twenty.
ex.s6: After every round, you see how much of each stock was bought, sold and held. Those numbers are your clues.
ex.s7: Once per game, you can hide one stock for two rounds. No one sees its price, or who hid it. Hold it, and even your own cash is hidden.
ex.s8: Until round twenty, a piece buys ten thousand marks in cash, or a private look at a rule's next hidden words. Only you see them.
ex.s9: Done trading? Press Ready. When everyone is ready, the round ends early.
ex.s10: After twenty-four rounds, the highest net worth wins. Can you crack the hidden rules before your rivals do?
ex.frozenChip: Prices stay fixed until the round ends
how.title: How to play
how.currency: Money is counted in Mystery Marks, written {symbol} — a script capital M, for “Mystery”. Say it “mark”: {example} is read “ten thousand marks”. It is a made-up currency; no real money is involved.
how.basics: Seven stocks open at {start}. You start with {cash} and 3 pieces. Prices never go below {floor}.
how.rounds: There are 24 rounds. Trade whole shares at the round's price — prices don't move within a round. When the round ends, every stock settles to a new price at once.
how.rules: Each stock moves by a hidden rule. A few words are shown at the start; more are revealed at rounds 5, 10, 15 and 20, when every rule is complete. Market-wide volume and holdings are published after each round.
how.secret: Once per game you may place a secret on one stock: it is hidden from everyone (price, stats and chart) for the next two rounds. Secrets are anonymous. Anyone holding a hidden stock can't see their own cash or net worth.
how.pieces: Until the end of round 20 a piece buys {piece} in cash, or a private peek at the next hidden words of one rule.
how.end: After round 24 the player with the highest net worth wins. Ties go to the player whose lowest net worth during the game was higher.
how.bots: Bots trade at the end of each round, after the humans, so they can react to that round's trades.
how.credit: Inspired by “Mystery Stock Market” from The Devil's Plan: Dead Again (season 3). The rules are a fan reconstruction; some words, the logo shape and the 3 starting pieces are our own additions. The currency is the made-up Mystery Mark (ℳ).
